title: Love numbers for a multistratified model

source.citation: Spada, G. et al. (2011). Geophysical Journal International 185(1), 106-132.

what_to_compute: As test 5/1, for the 28-layer model VSS96 instead of M3-L70-V01. The many layers make the root-finding of the normal mode method hard, which is the point of the test.

reference_data.$comment: Contributor abbreviations are those of the paper's table 1. For a converted test, the files read and what each column holds are in the `files` table of gia_mip/resources/spada_column_layouts.json. `not_converted` gives, per contributor, the reason its data is not in the converted file.

not_converted.GS: No file in T01-06/ carries GS in its path. The banner comments of love_PAP.gmt name GS for I106-M3-VSCAb-LLN-[hlk]-VK.mod, whose path says VK (attribution_disagreements in spada_column_layouts.json), and which of the two produced them is not established. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not Love numbers as functions of time, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.GSA: T01-06/ holds h.dat, l.dat, k.dat and the .mod files, attributed to GSA by the decoder. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not Love numbers as functions of time, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.RR: T01-06/ holds h_RR.dat, l_RR.dat and k_RR.dat. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not Love numbers as functions of time, so this test has no reader yet.
not_converted.VK: T01-06/ holds the I106-*-VK.mod and I107-*.dat files, with older copies in OLD-DATA/ and newer ones in NEW-DATA-FROM-VK/, and which set the paper used is not established. SpadaResult holds Love numbers with residues, relaxation spectra and surface profiles, and not Love numbers as functions of time, so this test has no reader yet.

status: not converted: no result class holds time-domain Love numbers, and models/vss96.json has no layer table.
